information.description:
Named for the author who could read a whole court from behind a screen. The Murasaki is the body Arasaka gives its negotiators, and it now sits in every room the Accord opened, the Liaison's chair included. The company's belief is that a loyal retainer's service shouldn't end when the first body does. Nor should the contract.

Cost: 16,000eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 56 (17d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): FBC Gemini Sculpt, Techhair, Shift Tacts
Chrome: AudioVox, Chipware Socket, Enhanced Holophone, Hidden Holster, Image Enhance ×2, Inconspicuous Cybereye Upgrade ×2, Self-ICE ×3, Skin Weave, Translation Chip, Voice Stress Analyzer

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
